label: Phoenix Contact FL SWITCH 2312-2GC-2SFP (12x 1G RJ45 + 2 combo + 2 SFP)
description: 12 x RJ45 10/100/1000 Mbps, 2 x combo ports (SFP or RJ45, 10/100/1000 Mbps) and 2 x SFP 100/1000 Mbps cages; DIN-rail managed switch (item 2702910, Managed Switch 2000 series). Family-wide: DIN rail, IP20, -40 to +70 C, 12-57 V DC supply, PROFINET Conformance Class B, IEC 62443-4-2 certified.
notes: Port census from the datasheet interface block: "Ethernet (RJ45): No. of channels 12 (RJ45 ports), 10/100/1000 Mbps"; "Ethernet (SFP): Number of interfaces 2, 100/1000 Mbps (full duplex), up to 80 km (depending on the SFP module used)"; "Ethernet (combo): Number of interfaces 2, Connection method SFP/RJ45, Transmission speed 10/100/1000 Mbps (full duplex)". One combo port is one physical port, so this chassis has 16 data ports, 85 mm wide. Switch functions: DHCP client / DHCP server (pool-based, port-based) / DHCP option 82 / BootP / DCP, MRP client and manager, RSTP, alarm digital output. No PoE: the datasheet lists no PoE/PSE interface and no power budget for this model, so no poe-pse capability is declared. Management is in-band only - the datasheet interfaces block lists Ethernet (RJ45), Ethernet (SFP) and Ethernet (combo) and nothing else, so no serial/console port is modelled. The datasheet publishes no switching-capacity / fabric-bandwidth figure, so none is stated here. Sources: datasheet https://www.phoenixcontact.com/us/products/2702910?type=pdf ; product page https://www.phoenixcontact.com/us/products/2702910.
